tools.name: search_kits
tools.description: Search nice to have, a shelf of ready-made build kits for Claude Code and Codex (step-by-step recipes with fixes for pitfalls found in real work). Use this whenever the user wants to make or build something — slides/decks, LINE stickers, pixel-art sprite animation, 3D/AR models from product photos,

tools.name: get_kit
tools.description: Get the details of one nice to have kit by id: what it does, the first three decisions, what you need, and the fixes it contains. Use after search_kits to explain a kit to the user.

tools.name: open_kit
tools.description: Use when the user pasted a nice to have line such as "…https://nicetohave.app/g/XXXXXXXX-YYYYYYYYYY のとおりに取り込んで" and you cannot download from nicetohave.app directly (for example, a cloud session with restricted network). Checks the sign-in ticket in that link and returns the list of the kit's files

tools.name: get_kit_file
tools.description: Get the content of one file listed by open_kit. Save it exactly as returned, at the same relative path inside the new kit folder. Long files come in parts: if the answer says part 1/3, call again with part 2 and 3 and append them in order without changing anything.

tools.name: list_kits
tools.description: List every kit currently on the nice to have shelf (id, name, what it does, page URL).
